subject: general
question: Under whose presidency did the Indian National Congress declare Poorna Swaraj as its ultimate goal on December 19, 1929, at Lahore?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Jawahar Lal Nehru.__**

__
 
• Congress passed the Poorna Swaraj resolution in December 19, 1929 in the Lahore session.

 
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru **was the president of the December 1929 Lahore session.
